latest_work.summary: Corrected the template-selection presentation surface after a new PPT request reached FAH WAIT_USER_ACTION without showing the picker inside ChatGPT. Conversational hosts now render the real live registered Slide Master previews in the current conversation first; external/local HTML GUI is fallback only when inline visual rendering is unavailable. Added template_gallery_chat_manifest.py so hosts can retrieve exact registered workspace and preview SVG paths without opening a browser. The accepted .fah/execution-contract.json v1.0 remains unchanged, preserving FAH runtime @45 CONTRACT_CURRENT compatibility.

fah_monitor_recovery.root_cause: repository source advanced after reviewed work while durable AI_STATE/latest handoff remained at onboarding bootstrap
fah_monitor_recovery.recovery_evidence: Subsequent natural monitor returned HEALTHY / ACCEPTED_AUTHORITY_CURRENT before Execution Contract rollout.

ppt_entry_routing_hardening.reason: Prevent FriendY PPT requests from entering upstream or generic presentation execution before FAH evaluation.

chat_inline_template_gallery.reason: Restore the previously working user experience where template previews and selection occur directly inside the ChatGPT conversation.

fixed_rules: Technical source of truth remains this repository.
FAH monitor uses durable CURRENT authority before stale Registry bootstrap values.
GitHub Actions are default-off to conserve usage; they may be used when the current user explicitly requests emergency deployment or explicitly requests GitHub Actions.
Runtime deployment, backup and rollback are enabled only for supported declared capabilities.
Unknown or conflicting authority fails closed and must not be auto-rebaselined.
Every meaningful ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, automation or other tool modification must update durable latest state/history/handoff before completion so later agents share the exact modification state.
Before meaningful project execution, evaluate the declared FAH execution contract; decisions other than ALLOW or EXEMPT must not proceed.
Project-local fail-closed guards remain mandatory even when the FAH central contract returns ALLOW or EXEMPT.

Every FriendY new-PPT request must first bind to canonical repository FriendY0421/slide-master; upstream byungjunjang/slide-master or generic presentation generators must not become execution authority before FAH evaluation.

For CREATE_PRESENTATION, missing valid TEMPLATE_SELECTION evidence is a blocking user-interaction state; show the live template gallery and wait for explicit user selection before research or generation.

On ChatGPT and other conversational hosts with visual rendering capability, the live template gallery must be rendered inside the current conversation using the actual registered previews; external/local HTML GUI is fallback only when inline visual rendering is unavailable.
next_priority: Normal operation: on every FriendY new presentation request, bind to FriendY0421/slide-master, evaluate FAH first, render the live registered template gallery directly inside the current conversation, wait for explicit selection and record template_selection.json evidence, then generate and verify the deck. Use external HTML/GUI only when inline visual rendering is technically unavailable. No FAH runtime deployment or contract SHA change is required for this correction.
